title: Bare metal platforms
summary: Give your teams reliable infrastructure they can provision, operate and change with confidence.
overview:
Your modern platform still depends on the metal, operating systems and lifecycle processes underneath it. When those foundations drift or rely on manual work, every layer above becomes harder to change.

We design and build automated infrastructure foundations across servers, provisioning and secure Linux baselines. Your teams get a repeatable platform they can understand, operate and evolve as demand changes.
positioning: Build reliable, automated foundations from the metal up, with the visibility and control to change them safely.
capabilities: Bare metal provisioning and lifecycle automation
outcomes: Provision environments with less manual effort
Give teams a foundation they can evolve
